scientific_integrity: Real finite equilateral BL norm; known anchored-equilateral limiting coefficient credited to arXiv:1911.10642. Finite rational checks supplement an analytic proof; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite equilateral metrics and nonnegative weights; no results on arbitrary metrics, general Mahler minimization, or the infinite-parameter point.
title: Exact Mahler-volume interpolation for equilateral bounded-Lipschitz norms
